Athenaeum (tarot, astrology, natal charts, spirits, spells, staves and runes, all offline, with a moon-phase widget) is an extra app of Pulse now: its Rust core is built into the app. Also: photo tools in the Toolkit (ASCII art, halftone QR, tilt-shift) and effects in the Photos editor, reading statistics, RSVP speed reading and free classics in the book reader, eye-comfort reader themes, PDF text search, a floating ink bar in Notes, smarter keyboard suggestions (your name and e-mail from their first letters, a saved-login prompt), shuffle and repeat modes for every music player, size and date in the Files detailed list for folders opened through root, and many fixes.

- YouTube (foss build only): a native client built on NewPipeExtractor. Search, trending and music; no Shorts. Videos open in Pulse's video player and songs play through Pulse's own music player.
- Net access: the Wi-Fi scan now finds every device on the network and shows the count and the addresses. The per-app access dialog uses tappable icons (grey when blocked) instead of switches.
- Music player (foss build): a new YouTube Music entry in the library settings searches songs and plays them in Pulse's own player.
